0000.note: The Rust kernel rewords some error messages; same errors otherwise (languages/l0000/CLAUDE.md, "The Rust implementation").

0003.note: Check errors name what was found more clearly ("the string \"dark\"" rather than "tag dark"); conformance compares them up to "Got" (languages/l0003/CLAUDE.md, "Conformance").
The TypeScript L0003 is on @graffiticode/l0000 0.8; the Rust kernel also has exact numbers and format-number, and serves those words (languages/l0003/CLAUDE.md, "Conformance").

0010.note: The TypeScript L0010 is on @graffiticode/l0000 0.8; the Rust kernel also has exact numbers and format-number (languages/l0010/CLAUDE.md, "Conformance").

0185.note: An L0000 error inside a record's function is the Rust kernel's message, not the TypeScript kernel's (languages/l0185/CLAUDE.md, "Conformance").
